# Spectra by ROMBO AI — full product overview

Spectra is a commercial web application for AI-assisted NMR compound identification, operated by ROMBO AI S.r.l. (Cagliari, Italy). Official site: {{ site.url }}/

## What it is
A scientific agent that loads 1H and 13C NMR data, retrieves candidate structures from large-scale libraries, ranks them with foundation models, compares predicted and measured shifts, and returns a shortlist with match information and residual error. The chemist confirms, dereplicates, or flags an unknown.

## Inputs
Nuclei: 1H, 13C. Source families: Bruker, JEOL, Varian. Exchange format: JCAMP-DX. Recommended metadata: solvent, field strength, analytical objective. Optional context: molecular formula, exact mass or MS.

## Outputs
Ranked shortlist, match values, 13C RMSD on the teaching example, shift-level evidence, review state.

## Access and pricing
Self-service login: {{ site.app_url }}/login (email, passkey, Google).
Pricing: {{ site.url }}/pricing/
- Free: 3 analyses
- Pro: EUR 79 / month, or EUR 790 / year
- Lab: EUR 299 / month, 5 users
- Enterprise: custom
Enterprise and Lab conversations: {{ site.url }}/pilot/

## Research
ROSE is a public 1H foundation model (code, weights, ChemRxiv). ROSE metrics are not Spectra product accuracy.
